name: Curse in Bloom
source:
To save her beloved knight from a curse, Lady Lavinia confronts a monster - but is she willing to betray her own heart?

[From [url=https://ebbasuke.itch.io/curseinbloom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
为了救心爱的骑士脱离诅咒，Lavinia女士挺身面对怪物——可她愿意背叛自己的内心吗？
